plan.archetype: Poison scaling with efficient attacks and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Build poison during sleep, establish dexterity before waking, and carry defensive potions. Preserve enough damage to finish before repeated siphons cripple defense.
plan.summary: Find an early shop to remove Greed and buy efficient damage or poison. Add defensive scaling and selective block upgrades. Take supported elites, not risky chains; preserve boss-entry health.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with Chemical X control and efficient defense
plan.bossPrep: Enter near full health. Establish scaling during sleep, maintain Weak, build poison, and carry emergency defense. Chemical X strengthens Malaise if found.
plan.summary: Prioritize dexterity, poison scaling, draw, and Chemical X debuffs. Remove Strikes rather than eternal curses. Avoid redundant attacks and risky elites; heal before dangerous fights and upgrade Weak or damage when safe.

plan.archetype: Free attacks and Chemical X control supporting scaling poison
plan.bossPrep: Enter near full health with defensive potions. Upgrade Malaise and Footwork when safe; retain mitigation for lasers and build poison on both parts.
plan.summary: Soup makes existing Strikes efficient and unremovable. Find Chemical X Malaise, dexterity, draw, and poison scaling. Replace Defends only after acquiring better block. Take the mandatory elite, avoid extras, and preserve both campfires.

plan.archetype: Chemical X control and poison scaling with urgent defensive repair
plan.bossPrep: Recover near full health, acquire defensive potions and permanent mitigation, retain answers for Rocket lasers, and poison both parts before committing to a kill.
plan.summary: The mandatory elite is the immediate crisis: use potions decisively. Keep both campfires and shops; buy survival tools first. Add dexterity, Chemical X Malaise, and efficient block. Remove Defends only after replacements; upgrade poison scaling when safe.
